paragraphs: Rungta International Skills University came into being only after Rungta Group of Institutions developed enough expertise and Academic Maturity in last 26 years, now ready to leverage upon it and succeeding in nurturing Future ready professionals equipped with future ready skills.

RIU will now offer Industry Immersive degree programmes within the holistic development framework of NEP 2020. Our outcome-focused skill-integrated model of professional education, backed by leading industry and sectoral partners in India and the world, assures not just employability, but assurance of a future ready professional with a global outlook ready to grab professional opportunities at National and International levels. Our flexible academic framework, mentors from professional world, faculty with vast experience in Skill development coupled with progressive pedagogies intrinsically focused on conceptual understanding of in demand skills, ensures development for future ready successful professionals.

Established in 1999 under the GDR Educational Society for Higher & Technical Education by Shri Ghanshyam Dasji Rungta, Rungta College began as a single engineering institute. Under the visionary leadership of Group Chairman Santosh Rungta, it expanded into a renowned educational group comprising four colleges in Engineering, Pharmacy, Commerce, and Science. In 2025, with official government approval, it transformed into Rungta International Skills University—Central India’s first private skill-focused university. Located on an 80-acre campus in Bhilai, it offers NAAC A Grade accredited, industry-aligned UG, PG, and doctoral programs across disciplines with global certifications from Google, Microsoft, and IBM.
